newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Shortland Props places shrs at NZ$0.94/shr.
newsitem.headline: Shortland Props places shrs at NZ$0.94/shr.

text.p: Shortland Properties said on Thursday it had made a placement of 21.7 million ordinary shares at 94 NZ cents per share, which would raise about $20 million.
"The placement was made following an approach from a major institutional investor," the property company said in a statement.
"As a result of this approach the placement will be made to this investor and a small number of existing institutional shareholders at $0.94 per share."
The shares would rank pari passu with existing ordinary shares. The total number of shares on issue after this allotment had taken place would be 202.86 million.

Shortland recently announced it would proceed with the construction of the Oracle Tower in Wakefield St, Auckland, and has also entered into an option agreement to purchase a further 37.8 percent of the units in the Property Trust of Australia.

"The placement will raise approximately $20 million which will be used to partially fund these investments as funds are required. In the intervening period the funds will be used to retire existing debt," Shortland said.
